author: Fosiposi
quote: What a beautiful game—it reminded me of my childhood just as it should. They've further refined that masterpiece from years past and adapted it perfectly to the present day. 1000/10
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Fosiposi
quote: A bad game—13 years in the making for what it costs. Between the bugs, the delays, and the irrelevant hype, it’s nowhere near what I expected. A waste of money. The in-house Simulator, the main character has zero personality, a vague story, and gameplay with pathetic NPC AI.
